title: Jurisdictional Lease Enforcement and Failover Guardrails for Private Deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a 'jurisdictional lease' mechanism for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments that enforces data residency, automates retention constraints, and constrains regional failover to auditable, policy-backed windows. The feature must provide tamper-evident evidence bundles for compliance reviews, deterministic failover decision logic, and a quarantine mode that prevents cross-jurisdiction execution while preserving availability where permitted.
acceptance_criteria: Lease issuance: control plane can mint a signed residency lease that encodes allowed jurisdictions, retention TTLs, and failover windows for a given deployment
Heartbeat & revocation: each private runtime instance heartbeats lease state; control plane can revoke or shrink a lease and runtime enforces revocation within the configured grace period

Quarantine behavior: when a runtime detects lease expiry or revocation it enters quarantine: stops routing requests outside permitted jurisdictions, flushes cache to local encrypted store, and serves only safety-allowlisted low-risk APIs
Failover policy enforcement: automated failover only occurs within pre-authorized windows or to explicitly permitted standby jurisdictions; any deviation is blocked and must create an evidence bundle

Evidence bundles: system produces signed, immutable bundles (signed metadata, KMS audit log references, routing decisions, timestamps) suitable for compliance export and includes a tamper-evident hash
Observability: console shows lease state, last heartbeat, pending revocation, and a timeline of routing decisions with token-level cost/latency deltas
Regression: automated end-to-end tests that simulate lease revocation, network partition, and cross-jurisdiction request attempts pass in CI
Security review: design reviewed and approved by security & compliance org before merge
tasks: Spec: produce PRD that defines lease schema, revocation semantics, quarantine mode, and evidence bundle format
Runtime: implement lease verifier and enforced policy layer in serving runtime
Control plane: endpoint to mint, modify, and revoke leases; admin UI controls
Networking: enforce egress filters and route policies tied to lease constraints
Storage: design encrypted local cache flush flow and retention metadata wiring to KMS
Evidence: implement bundle assembler with signatures and S3/Drive export hooks
Console: surface lease state, failover gating UI, and downloadable evidence artifacts
Tests: unit, integration, and chaos tests for revocation and geo-partition scenarios
Docs: runbook and compliance playbook for customer-facing support and audits
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only with two Redwood-managed private clusters (us-west-2 EU-west-1) to validate issuance and revocation flows
Beta: invite 3 enterprise customers with strict residency needs; enable read-only lease monitoring for all Private customers
GA: configurable leases in the private deployment wizard; on-by-default for new Private clusters; migration tooling for existing clusters
Fallback: default safe-mode prevents automatic cross-jurisdiction failover unless customer opts-in and signs SLA amendment
telemetry_and_alerting: Heartbeat metric: lease.heartbeat.latency per-cluster with alert if missed for > lease_grace_period
Revocation events: audit.revocation.{issuer,cluster,reason} emitted to audit log store
Quarantine triggers: security.alert.quarantine with list of impacted routes and last known lease hash
Failover block: routing.blocked.{from,to} with evidence bundle id attached
Evidence export success/failure: evidence.export.{ok,fail} with S3/Drive URI or error
notes: We intentionally use a short, signed lease model instead of a static 'region allowlist' to enable rapid revocation during incidents and provide stronger audit trails.
Evidence bundles will not contain raw customer payloads; instead they include hashed request identifiers, routing decisions, and pointers to encrypted logs under KMS control.
Consider integration with existing KMS/HSM flow (secret manager) to sign leases and evidence bundles; discuss key hierarchy with security team.
Edge case: how to handle multi-jurisdiction datasets within a single request — design will fallback to conservative blocking and escalate to manual operator workflow.
